name: compression
title: Compression
description: Compress/decompress throughput for Lyo.Compression across GZip, Deflate, Zstd, Snappier, LZ4, LZMA, BZip2, XZ (and Brotli/ZLib on net10.0). Buffered suites use seeded deterministic (incompressible) buffers at 100/250/500 MiB. Large suites (100 MiB–2 GiB) cover stream APIs (DeterministicPayloadStream → NullingStream) and file APIs (IOTemp paths). Ratio on random data is not meaningful — these measure speed and framing.
